decisions.reason: Being moved to its own page in 2024 shows rising commitment, and a low-cost care consumable that complements the core flooring business is an option worth keeping.
Its prospects are still uncertain, but the maintenance oil costs little to keep listed and fits the floor-care range, so keeping the option open is cheap.
Promotion to a dedicated page signals positive early results, which justifies further commitment to this care product for oiled floors.
The underlay is a low-cost complementary accessory sold alongside floors, and it is too early to conclude its value will not be realized.
The high-density underlay overlaps somewhat with Product D, but keeping it costs little and the uncertainty about which underlay performs better has not yet resolved.
The oak parquet is close to the firm's core wood competence and anchors the care and underlay products, so keeping it is worthwhile while results are still developing.
